Add setting, `autoUpdateDiscTotal` (backed by @AppStorage) in `SwiftTag/Features/Settings/TagWriteSettingsView.swift` after "Auto update Track Total by Disc" as a Toggle labeled "Auto update Disc Total". - When this setting is On, then `TOTALDISCS` is set for all tracks as the calculated count of discs based on the maximum `DISCNUMBER` found across tracks. - When this setting is Off, then `TOTALDISCS` is not auto calculated. 2. Add in `File` menu after `Set Track Total by Disc` a menu item labeled `Set Disc Total (<disc count>)` - When this menu item is selected, the `TOTALDISCS` of each track of key editor window is set to count of discs. - This menu is enabled when `autoUpdateDiscTotal` is Off and there are tracks in a key editor window (similar to how `Set Track Total` is handled). - The displayed menu title should follow a similar paradigm as `Set Track Total`, but where "()" encloses disc count (e.g. `Set Disc Total (3)` would indicate that there are three discs across tracks as determined by maximum `DISCNUMBER` across tracks). 3. Add `Set Disc Total (<disc count>)` command to track table context menu as well. 4. Expose the new setting, `auto update disc

Alias behavior: `TOTALDISCS` is the the same as `DISCTOTAL`, so yes, preserve aliases. 4. Yes, disable Total Discs field while auto update is on. 5. `Set Disc Total (0)`: should be disabled. Total disc field format bug: 1. Auto update Disc Total is Off 2. Execute Set Disc Total 3.
